verdicts.title: On the α-Invariants of Cubic Surfaces with Eckardt Points
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: In this paper, we show that the α_{m,2}-invariant of a smooth cubic surface with Eckardt points is strictly bigger than 2/3. This can be used to simplify Tian's original proof of the existence of Kaehler-Einstein metrics on such manifolds. We also sketch the computations on cubic surfaces with one ordinary double points, and outline the analytic difficulties to prove the existence of orbifold Kaehler-Einstein metrics.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns α-invariants and Kähler-Einstein metrics on smooth cubic surfaces with Eckardt points, a differential geometry/algebraic geometry topic with no mention of integer points, CNF formulas, or Boolean complexity.
